reason: Theorem: for a 2-group G acting on F_2[x]/(x^2-x) by variable permutations (swap, D_4) - or any action fixing an F_2-point P - the constant 1 is never in Tr_G(V) for ANY G-stable V. Proof: ev_P is G-invariant, so ev_P(Tr w)=|G| ev_P(w)=0 in char 2, while ev_P(1)=1. Equivalently Tr(monomial m)=|Stab(m)|*orbitsum(m), zero for non-free orbits; Tr image = span of free-orbit sums, all of which have zero coefficient on the fixed monomial 1. Hence c*_Tr = infinity on every UNSAT instance; the falsifier's prediction_if_true is impossible; the refutation certificate is always 'cohomological' (1 spans a class in H^0-hat). Numeric check: n=4, swap(x1,x2), deg<=3 multilinear: 15 monomials, 4 free orbits, constant in none. Nongenericity: none claimed (B*D^2 unchanged), constant-factor device only.
fix: Weakened form (accounting at best): use orbit-sum (fixed-point) space W_c^G / invariant-ring reduction rather than transfer image; 1 in W_c iff 1 in W_c^G trivially, but cost of computing W_c^G without characters is not /|G| in general (Tate defect a_c is exactly what must be paid). Alternatively test certificates of form Tr(w)+f with f in ideal over fixed point-free affine actions (x->x+1 translations, FGHR 2-torsion) where no G-fixed F_2-point exists; only there can 1 lie in Tr image.
scope_of_kill: Any 2-group action over F_2 with a fixed F_2-rational point (all permutation actions). Not covered: fixed-point-free affine actions.
